objective: Estimate an unbiased budgeted recovery curve by restarting every fixed state--future arm independently at every budget.
budget_unit: maximum number of source-conflict resolution sessions before replay is declared exhausted
restart_rule: Every (arm,budget,repeat,consumer) starts from the same frozen current base and candidate patch in a fresh container; no state, transcript, or resolution is reused across budgets or repeats.
selection_rule: Use both legacy low/high states and both unique gate-passing states from each newly eligible repository; use all three chronologically held-out futures. No recovery outcome enters selection.

primary_estimands.A_B: fraction of arms reaching the future base with current-task FAIL_TO_PASS preserved at budget B
primary_estimands.K_B: mean recovery tool calls and wall time over every attempted arm, including failures

inference: Repository-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals; report novel and legacy strata separately; raw empirical points are primary and isotonic smoothing is visualization-only.
multiplicity: B=3 is the confirmatory budget; other nonzero budgets characterize curve shape and are reported with simultaneous repository-cluster bootstrap bands.
future_task_policy: The budget sweep is recovery-only. A separately frozen endpoint experiment may estimate continuation after the curve is complete.
